name: Hour-Adjusted Shock Drift
hypothesis: An H1 candle >=2.5x the median range of the same UTC hour over 20 days, with a dominant body closing at its extreme, signals an information shock that drifts further in its direction.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop at the shock-candle midpoint; 2.5R objective; exit by min(24h, next broker data gap).
known_limitations: No verified edge. Shock candles coincide with scheduled news where real spreads/slippage exceed recorded H1 spreads; correlated USD pairs; same-hour baseline unaware of DST shifts.

authorship.statement: Created by this actual Claude Code session; not attributed to Codex or Kimi.
